visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit classroom, three female figures are positioned in a synchronized arrangement. An adult woman with long dark hair stands in the center background wearing a white sleeveless crop top and dark leggings. In front of her, two young girls are seated on red plastic stools. The girl on the left wears a white t-shirt and blue shorts with her hair in braided pigtails, while the girl on the right has long loose hair and a light pink shirt. All three individuals hold silver flutes in a professional playing posture, with their fingers actively pressing keys and their eyes focused forward. (2) The setting includes a green bulletin board on the left wall decorated with various notices and a closed light-blue door in the background. The floor is covered in neutral-toned square tiles. The camera remains static throughout, capturing the trio as they maintain their positions, with subtle upper-body swaying and precise finger movements on the instruments. Large white text with a black outline is overlaid at the bottom of the frame, and numbered markers '1', '2', and '3' are placed near each participant.

It features three individuals mimicking a flute performance simultaneously, challenging the audience to use their observation and listening skills to determine which person is actually playing the live music being heard.
